jobs.title: Growth Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare growth-operations role centered on automated workflows, campaign QA, attribution, marketing technology, AI tools, process documentation and cross-functional handoffs. Kevin’s marketing background plus workflow automation, reporting and systems operations maps very well without making SEO the core job.
jobs.gap: Garner wants 4–5+ years specifically in Marketing/Revenue Operations and deep email/SMS automation experience, preferably Iterable. Kevin should emphasize transferable CRM/automation and campaign-operations work without overstating platform depth.

jobs.title: Practice Operations Manager I
jobs.why: Direct healthcare practice-operations leadership role covering clinical practice efficiency, patient experience, compliance, staffing and administrative operations. Kevin’s ABA healthcare operations, intake, training, recruiting and workflow ownership are highly relevant.
jobs.gap: The range starts below Kevin’s target, so the role only qualifies if the offer lands near the top of the posted range. Academic medical-center practice management is also a different environment from ABA operations.

jobs.title: Core Operations Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare systems/operations role focused on process improvement, provider setup, credentialing, claims operations, vendor coordination, Jira/ServiceNow and cross-functional system initiatives. Kevin’s healthcare intake/credentialing workflows, systems projects and operational automation align strongly.
jobs.gap: MetroPlus asks for 5–7 years specifically in healthcare payer systems, including claims processing, benefit configuration, provider data and systems migration. That payer-systems depth is Kevin’s biggest gap.

jobs.title: Clinical Speciality Programs & Operations Manager - NY
jobs.why: Healthcare operations role building scalable workflows, SOPs, referral/intake pathways, staffing models, KPI reporting and process improvements. Kevin’s ABA intake, training, staffing, compliance and workflow-design experience maps closely.
jobs.gap: Atria asks for 5+ years in healthcare operations/clinical program management and prefers Lean/Six Sigma plus EHR depth. The five-day onsite requirement is also significant.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Full-cycle healthcare technology implementation covering project scope, timelines, training, stakeholder alignment, workflow optimization and documentation. Kevin’s systems/project work, healthcare operations, onboarding and training are transferable, and the employer explicitly notes transferable skills can work well.
jobs.gap: Fusion prefers 5+ years and hands-on EHR implementation, configuration, data migration and validation. The salary only clears Kevin’s target at the upper end; SQL/API experience is a plus, so Kevin should describe SQL only as foundational/working knowledge.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager (Process)
jobs.why: Mental-health technology role focused on automating revenue workflows, cross-functional process redesign, AI-powered operations and scalable provider GTM systems. Kevin’s behavioral-health context, workflow automation and operations background are relevant.
jobs.gap: Headway seeks 5–7 years in RevOps/Business Operations/Strategy plus strong AI workflow fluency; related versions of the role also emphasize data interrogation. Kevin should not imply advanced SQL or Python proficiency and should position his practical automation experience as the bridge.
